pages.text: Core temperature decides everything. Know these numbers.

pages.title: Thresholds
pages.text: $(bold)350°C$(): warning, klaxon, rods lock$(br)$(bold)450°C$(): automatic SCRAM$(br)$(danger)600°C$(): permanent damage$(br)$(danger)700°C$(): loss of coolant$(br)$(danger)800°C$(): meltdown

pages.title: SCRAM
pages.text: SCRAM drops the rods. Manual SCRAM always saves the core.$(br2)A trip stays latched until $(bold)Reset$(). Reset is refused under redstone, or at 450°C or hotter with auto-SCRAM on.

pages.title: Decay Heat
pages.text: After a SCRAM the core still makes 7% heat, fading to 1% over a day. Keep the radiators working.

pages.title: Damage
pages.text: Above 600°C the core is damaged 0.2% per second, up to 75%. Damage cuts electrical output, never fission heat.

pages.title: Auto-SCRAM
pages.text: You can turn off automatic SCRAM behind two confirmations. $(danger)Only then can the core melt down.$()$(br2)$(flavor)See History.$()
